name: Euro Technology Sector Equity ETF
description: UCITS ETF providing concentrated exposure to European technology and digitisation companies. Single-sector equity funds exhibit VEV 22-30% under PRIIPs methodology (higher than diversified equity due to sector concentration); MRM class 5 (VEV 20-30%) + CRM class 1 (equity) → SRI 5 per Commission Delegated Regulation EU 2017/653 Annex II. Analogous to ESMA-observed high-SRRI UCITS funds (SRRI 6) reclassifying to SRI 5 under PRIIPs (LPA, 2021). Classified NON-COMPLEX as an admitted UCITS ETF under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a); sector concentration risk and higher volatility are understood from standard fund documentation.
